policy: V30 makes remaining distribution entitlement aware of canonical refunds of post-close settlement fees and new reversal-processing fees. Refund restoration is allowed only against an exact post-close settlement-fee ReportingEntry for the same affected period and can never exceed that original fee. Principal reversal semantics remain the existing capital restoration path.

additions.authority_note: Ledger-derived entitlement state. Net post-close distribution fee cost = settlement fee expense - canonical original-fee refund + reversal-processing fee. Fee refund cannot exceed the referenced post-close fee, restored entitlement cannot exceed the original gross period budget, and no authorization/payment/execution/AI authority is granted.
